# rhoai-gpu-labs/llm-finetune-workbench/prod.yaml
__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: "LLM Fine-Tuning Workbench (2x L40S)"
    category: Workshops
  deployer:
    type: agnosticd
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

config: openshift-cluster
cloud_provider: aws
worker_instance_type: g6e.12xlarge
worker_instance_count: 2
ocp4_workload_rhoai_enable: true
ocp4_workload_nvidia_gpu_operator_enable: true
